tokens.name: normal-font
tokens.usage: NORMAL_FONT_COLOR, the game's gold: labels, headings and titles on dark frames (GameFontNormal). On `frame-ground` and `tooltip-ground`.

tokens.name: highlight-font
tokens.usage: HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR: values, names and anything hovered or selected on dark frames (GameFontHighlight). On `frame-ground` and `tooltip-ground`.

tokens.name: disabled-font
tokens.usage: DISABLED_FONT_COLOR / GRAY_FONT_COLOR: unavailable choices and secondary notes on dark frames (GameFontDisable).

tokens.name: lightgray-font
tokens.usage: LIGHTGRAY_FONT_COLOR: quiet notes on dark frames, a step above `disabled-font`.

tokens.name: red-font
tokens.usage: RED_FONT_COLOR: errors, unmet requirements, money spent (GameFontRed). On dark frames only; on parchment use `dim-red-font`.

tokens.name: dim-red-font
tokens.usage: DIM_RED_FONT_COLOR: a softer red for warnings that should not shout.

tokens.name: green-font
tokens.usage: GREEN_FONT_COLOR: met requirements, gains, success (GameFontGreen). On dark frames.

tokens.name: yellow-font
tokens.usage: YELLOW_FONT_COLOR: pure yellow for alerts and new things; not a substitute for `normal-font`.

tokens.name: lightyellow-font
tokens.usage: LIGHTYELLOW_FONT_COLOR: flavour text in tooltips (item descriptions, quotes).

tokens.name: orange-font
tokens.usage: ORANGE_FONT_COLOR: cautions between yellow and red.

tokens.name: blue-font
tokens.usage: BLUE_FONT_COLOR: system links and hints.

tokens.name: passive-spell-font
tokens.usage: PASSIVE_SPELL_FONT_COLOR: passive effects in tooltips.

tokens.name: parchment-text
tokens.usage: PARCHMENT_MATERIAL_TEXT_COLOR: running text on parchment (quest descriptions, objectives). On `parchment-ground`.

tokens.name: parchment-title
tokens.usage: PARCHMENT_MATERIAL_TITLETEXT_COLOR: headings set in the quest title face on parchment.

tokens.name: quest-title-brown
tokens.usage: QuestFont_Shadow_Huge's colour: the brown-gold of section headings on parchment ("Rewards", "Description").

tokens.name: objective-font
tokens.usage: QUEST_OBJECTIVE_FONT_COLOR: objectives in the objective tracker, on the world.

tokens.name: objective-highlight-font
tokens.usage: QUEST_OBJECTIVE_HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR: a hovered objective.

tokens.name: objective-disabled-font
tokens.usage: QUEST_OBJECTIVE_DISABLED_FONT_COLOR: an objective already done.

tokens.name: parchment-ground
tokens.usage: The spellbook page's parchment (spellbook-Page-Right-C60), roughly: only for a flat fill where the page cannot be used.

tokens.name: frame-ground
tokens.usage: The rock ground of windows (UI-Background-Rock, its average): only for a flat fill where the texture cannot be used.

tokens.name: tooltip-ground
tokens.usage: TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR, the tint over UI-Tooltip-Background: the tooltip's dark blue-black.

tokens.name: tooltip-border
tokens.usage: TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_COLOR: the tint of the tooltip's border (white leaves its silver as drawn).

tokens.name: quality-poor
tokens.usage: ITEM_POOR_COLOR: names of Poor (grey junk) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-common
tokens.usage: ITEM_STANDARD_COLOR: names of Common (white) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-uncommon
tokens.usage: ITEM_GOOD_COLOR: names of Uncommon (green) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-rare
tokens.usage: ITEM_SUPERIOR_COLOR: names of Rare (blue) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-epic
tokens.usage: ITEM_EPIC_COLOR: names of Epic (purple) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-legendary
tokens.usage: ITEM_LEGENDARY_COLOR: names of Legendary (orange) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: quality-artifact
tokens.usage: ITEM_ARTIFACT_COLOR: names of Artifact (pale gold) items, in links, tooltips and loot.

tokens.name: difficulty-impossible
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.impossible: a quest's level and title, five or more levels above you.

tokens.name: difficulty-verydifficult
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.verydifficult: a quest's level and title, three or four above.

tokens.name: difficulty-difficult
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.difficult: a quest's level and title, about your level.

tokens.name: difficulty-standard
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.standard: a quest's level and title, a little below.

tokens.name: difficulty-trivial
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.trivial: a quest's level and title, far below: little reward.

tokens.name: difficulty-header
tokens.usage: QuestDifficultyColors.header: a quest's level and title, zone headers in quest lists.

styles.name: GameFontNormalLarge
styles.usage: Window titles and big numbers, gold.

styles.name: QuestTitleFont

tokens.name: window-corner
tokens.usage: Forever's frame corners (-c60), drawn at their atlas size; the top-left holds the portrait ring.

tokens.name: window-title
tokens.usage: The title strip at a window's top; the title centred in it.

tokens.name: inset-edge
tokens.usage: InsetPanel corners; its edge tiles are 3px.

tokens.name: tooltip-edge
tokens.usage: Tooltip nine-slice corners and edges.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: RedButton height (22 to 26).

tokens.name: checkbox-size
tokens.usage: checkbox-minimal, 30x29.

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: SearchBox height; its art is 40 tall, drawn smaller.

tokens.name: stat-line
tokens.usage: A StatList line: label and value, ruled underneath.

tokens.name: title-plate
